study type: Retrospective cohort study by case-control design
exposure: Maternal exposure to diurnal temperature variation (DTV) during preconception and prenatal periods
cohort: 1510 children (699 with pneumonia and 811 normal controls) under the age of 14
finding: Exposure to increased DTV during the year before conception and throughout pregnancy, particularly in the first and second trimesters, was significantly associated with an increased risk of childhood pneumonia.
